hypotheses.title: Standalone Quality-Filtered Hydrothermal Upflow & Oblique Transfer-Zone Detector (H30-2 / H30-3)
hypotheses.signature: Station-deduplicated well/spring thermal excess (T - 20 C > 0, T <= 350 C), quartz/chalcedony/cation geothermometer excess (max T_geo - 50 C > 0), and oblique transfer-zone strike-rotation boundaries (|grad cos(2*theta_mag)| + |grad sin(2*theta_mag)|) weighted by geodetic shear rate.
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: Nearly 50% of Great Basin geothermal systems are blind (no surface fault rupture; Faulds & Hinz 2015) due to smectite/illite clay caps and young alluvial cover, and transverse transfer zones fracture into distributed small-offset shears omitted by scarp-focused aerial/LiDAR mapping.
hypotheses.confounders: Lateral down-hydraulic-gradient warm-water outflow plumes in permeable piedmont gravels; clustered agricultural/municipal well fields; pre-Cenozoic plutonic/thrust contacts.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: Addendum D (H27-12) tested only Euclidean distance to well/spring coordinates regardless of temperature (+0.0005 PR-AUC, refuted). Incorporated as bands 5-7 of the promoted H30-1 stack; standalone ablation without up-dip potential-field advection remains untried.
hypotheses.data_gate: Hash-pinned gdr_wellspring_in_footprint.csv (27,092 rows) and raster bands already staged in data_cache/.
hypotheses.validation: Included inside promoted H30-1 (seeds 240-244, canary AUCs 0.5390, 0.5666, 0.5700); standalone ablation requires fresh seeds >= 245.
hypotheses.status: PARTIALLY TESTED INSIDE PROMOTED H30-1; standalone ablation untried.

hypotheses.title: Continuous Soft-Probability Kernel-Deconvolved Emission under Exact Continuous DTI
layers: Calibrated OOF/full probability surfaces p(x) in [0, 1] from H30-1 (55-band hybrid detector)
hypotheses.signature: Emit calibrated continuous weights p(x) in {0} U [p_min, 1] on Poisson-disk ridge centres instead of hard binary {0, 1} thresholding.
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: Retains moderate-probability (p in [0.15, 0.50]) buried/sub-alluvial fault corridors that hard top-K binary thresholding discards, hedging positional uncertainty across the 300 m kernel.
hypotheses.confounders: Diffuse probability halos on rough terrain accumulating linear 0.2 * sum(p) false-positive cost faster than max_x p(x)*k(d) grows.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: All 25 peer and in-repo rasters emit binary {0.0, 1.0} dots; continuous soft-probability emission has not been tested in GEMSDOE27.
hypotheses.cost: medium; requires continuous-weight optimization on ridge centres
hypotheses.validation: Preregister on fresh seeds >= 245 and compare against binary H30-1.

hypotheses.title: Add three official GDR 1391 layers that are absent from the detector (H30-5)
layers: Paleo-geothermal sinter/tufa/travertine and altered-bedrock regional vectors
hypotheses.signature: Independent surface and shallow-subsurface thermal/chemical/volcanic evidence for fault-focused fluid flow and young deformation; test each layer family separately before any combination.
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: A permeable fault can localize hydrothermal alteration, thermal anomalies, or young volcanic alignments even where no Quaternary surface trace is catalogued.
hypotheses.confounders: Sampling density, groundwater transport, non-fault heat sources, volcanic contacts unrelated to the target fault, and the fact that prior thermal-point-distance features were nearly null.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: The checkout currently holds 21 vent points and 27,092 well/spring rows, but not these regional paleo-geothermal features, 2 m probes, or volcanics polygons.
hypotheses.cost: medium-high; blocked in sandbox because gdr.openei.org is outside outbound allowlist
hypotheses.data_gate: Official GDR #1391 listing (https://gdr.openei.org/submissions/1391) and hash pins exist, but raw packages are absent from this checkout and unreachable from the sandbox allowlist (github.com only).
hypotheses.validation: After raw-data inventory, preregister a separate spatial holdout with unused seeds >= 245.
